fields.description:
Build the one-time strip as a committed operational script, and prove it on a scratch clone before
any window. **No new dependency**: `git-filter-repo` is deliberately not used. session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).

## Why stock plumbing
`git fast-export --no-data --signed-tags=strip --export-marks=old.marks tickets` | filter |
`git fast-import --export-marks=new.marks`. Verified on the real branch: the stream carries
`M 100644 <sha> <path>` with **zero** inline blob data (26 MB stream for ~49,900 commits), so the
filter is line-oriented text processing that never moves the ~1 GiB. No `deleteall`; no tags in a
branch export (so `--signed-tags=strip` is a harmless no-op); merges ride `merge :n`; **empty commits
are kept**, so DAG topology and every file's introduction point survive — which is exactly what
ancestry-based authorship verification needs. `git-filter-repo --prune-empty=never` can preserve
empty commits, but this epic deliberately uses stock Git because it is already required and the
measured plumbing pipeline needs no additional operational dependency; the choice does not rely on
a claim that filter-repo is incapable.

**Proven result:** 1,172,586,762 -> 98,803,422 bytes (8.4%), all commits and all merge commits
preserved, HEAD tree byte-identical except the intended paths, ~30 s end to end.

## Required corrections (each was a real defect found in review)
1. Must run in a fresh **UNFILTERED** clone — `fast-import` hard-fails `fatal: blob not found` in a
   `blob:none` partial clone, and this host's `origin` is one.
2. Strip **both** `.bridge_state/` **and** `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/` prefixes — story
   `4804-d9eb-e682-4d9c` removes the latter at HEAD only; session log
   `1cb6-d553-6565-49b4` records the measured 33 MB retained in history.
3. **Derive the re-add set DYNAMICALLY** — `git ls-tree -r --name-only <old-tip> -- .bridge_state/` —
   never a hardcoded list. Story `9594-1f1c-bcd1-4774` added `get_rotation.json`, so the current store has four
   files; a hardcoded list would fail the tree-identity assertion and any future extension.
4. The filter must be **`data <n>`-length-aware**, not `grep -v`: commit messages live inside `data`
   blocks. (Today 0 of ~49,900 messages begin with `M `/`D `, but the script must not rely on that.)

+## Publication constraint (owned by A6-1, not this script)
+The dry-run script performs no push. The A6-1 operator step must re-check the observed remote tip and
+publish with **`--force-with-lease`**, never `--force`. A lease failure means the remote moved; abort
+without publication and rerun the dry-run from a fresh unfiltered clone of the new tip.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [code-verifiable] On a scratch unfiltered clone, the script produces a rewritten branch whose **commit count and
      merge-commit count are unchanged** (measured at run time, not hardcoded). Tier: **repo-level
      assertion in the dry-run harness**.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] `rev-parse <new-tip>^{tree}` **equals** the old tip tree after the dynamic re-add. Tier:
      **repo-level assertion**. This is the "not one byte of live content changed" invariant.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The re-add set is discovered from `ls-tree`, proven by a fixture where a 4th `.bridge_state`
      file exists. Tier: **integration** with a synthetic 4-file store.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The rewritten branch contains zero commits touching
      `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/`, proven by an empty
      `git log rewritten-tickets -- .bridge_state.bak-retarget/`. Tier: **repo-level assertion**.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] Pack size of a fresh unfiltered clone of the rewritten branch is **<=150 MB**. Tier:
+      **repo-level measurement**, matching the parent epic's ceiling.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The filter preserves a commit message that begins with `M ` (adversarial fixture). Tier:
      **unit** on the stream filter.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] The script refuses to run in a partial clone, with a clear message. Tier: **integration**
      against a `--filter=blob:none` clone.
- [ ] [code-verifiable] All assertions run **before** any push; the script has no push step of its own.

## Verification commands
- Stream-filter unit oracle: `pytest tests/unit/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py -v`.
- Synthetic four-file, partial-clone refusal, DAG/tree, history-removal, pack-size, and
  representative-writer oracles: `pytest tests/integration/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py -v`.
- Repository gates: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test`.

## Files
`infra/scripts/reclaim_bridge_history.py`,
+`tests/unit/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py`, and
+`tests/integration/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py`

Scope: M. No code dependencies; must exist before A6-1.

## Parent-review propagation

Before any publication, the dry-run harness also exercises a representative post-rewrite writer.

- [ ] [code-verifiable] In temporary real clones rooted at the rewritten branch, append and push a representative
      review-bot ticket commit, then prove `git merge-base --is-ancestor <old-tip> <new-tip>` is
      false and incremental `size-pack` growth is <1 MB. All of this runs before any push to
      origin. Tier: repo integration.
